messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Triton Labs reported a peering restart at 02:14 UTC, on-prem bridge dropped and their traffic was blackholed for ~11m. Initial quick triage: MTU mismatch + our isolation-controller re-applying stale routes on flap. Posting notes + actions.

Diego Ramos: saw the logs: `BGP_SESSION DOWN` -> `ROUTE_RELOAD`. MTU mismatch on edge-bridge v0.9.1, lots of retransmits.

Iris Patel: this is the third Triton incident in ~6 weeks. Pattern: link flaps + jumbo frames -> our adapters flip into a state that triggers route reapply.

Samir Gupta: assigning owners/timeline: I will own the bridge hotfix + test harness. @Diego take the isolation-controller rollback/reapply bug.

Diego Ramos: @Samir got it. I'll open a PR to stop aggressive route reapply and add unit + integration tests.

Maya Chen: Ops mitigation while fixes land: increase BGP hold timer for affected peers and pin routes on flap. @ops-bot please create a runbook draft for Triton short-term steps.

ops-bot: Runbook draft created: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/triton-onprem-bridging (auto) :white_check_mark:

Iris Patel: Action items summary:
- Hotfix deploy (owner: Samir) — ETA 48h
- Controller patch (owner: Diego) — ETA 72h
- Customer config doc (owner: Maya) — ETA EOD tomorrow
- Postmortem writeup + customer sync (owner: Iris) — ETA 3 business days

Samir Gupta: Hotfix steps (notes): patch bridge -> disable aggressive route reapply; quick test snippet I used locally: ```bash
# simulate flap
ip link set dev eth1 down && sleep 1 && ip link set dev eth1 up
# check routes
ip route show table main
```
Will run canary after smoke tests.

Diego Ramos: I'll add an integration test that simulates MTU variation + repeated flaps. Draft PR: `github.com/redwood/edge-controller/pull/482` (draft).

Maya Chen: Reaching out to Triton PM to request a maintenance window tomorrow 10–11 UTC for hotfix canary. Also asking if increasing BGP hold is acceptable as temporary mitigation.

Iris Patel: Recurring-pattern note for eval: customers with jumbo frames + 10Gbps on-prem links show higher flap sensitivity. We should add a console detection alert `onprem-mtu-mismatch` and an advisory in onboarding. I'll file a ticket.

Samir Gupta: Created tracking ticket for alerting/remediation: INC-7892.

Diego Ramos: Also found isolation-controller bug: it doesn't respect `peering.stableAfter` during quick flaps -> causes immediate route reapply. Adding regression test.

Maya Chen: Customer comms plan: brief timeline + next steps. I'll share the draft message here before sending.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for hotfix to 5% of Dedicated customers at 2023-12-08T14:00Z (automated schedule).

Iris Patel: Quick follow-ups checklist: - owners confirmed; - ETAs set; - runbook link present; - PRs/tickets listed; - customer sync scheduled. Anything else? :eyes:

Samir Gupta: I'll update the central remediation tracker spreadsheet once hotfix is merged.

Diego Ramos: tagging @Maya once PR is ready for canary and when integration tests pass.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll post the formal postmortem doc here once RC validated. Marking this thread for weekly follow-up until all items closed. :thumbsup:
